summary: Comprehensive responsiveness audit completed across 9 viewports (360x740 to 2560x1440) and all 5 slides. Mobile viewports (< 768px) are PERFECT with no issues. Desktop viewports have critical CTA overlap issue on slide-2 and navigation failures. Admin login page is fully responsive.

critical_bugs.issue: CTA buttons ('Отримати прайс від виробника' and 'Продукція') overlap with floating 'Зв'язатися' button at bottom-right on ALL desktop viewports
affected_viewports: iPad Landscape (1024x768): CTA bottom at 766px, floating button at 700px
MacBook 13 (1280x800): CTA bottom at 798px, floating button at 732px
MacBook 15 (1440x900): CTA bottom at 898px, floating button at 832px
FullHD (1920x1080): CTA bottom at 1078px, floating button at 1012px
QHD (2560x1440): CTA bottom at 1438px, floating button at 1372px
critical_bugs.root_cause: Slide 2 content extends down and CTAs at bottom of slide overlap with fixed-position floating button. Only iPad Portrait (768x1024) doesn't have overlap due to taller viewport.
critical_bugs.recommendation: Adjust slide-2 layout to ensure CTAs end before floating button position, or adjust floating button position to be higher, or add bottom padding to slide content to create clearance.

critical_bugs.component: Desktop Navigation - Right Rail & Arrow Keys
critical_bugs.issue: Right rail page number clicks and arrow key navigation fail to change slides after page reload. Expected to navigate to slide-3, but stays on current slide.
critical_bugs.root_cause: Navigation event handlers may not be properly initialized after page reload, or there's a timing issue with the cooldown mechanism preventing immediate navigation.
critical_bugs.recommendation: Debug FullPage.jsx navigation handlers (keyboard, right rail clicks). Check if cooldown lock is preventing navigation after page load. Verify event listeners are properly attached.

ui_bugs.issue: Text overflow detected in badge elements across all slides on desktop viewports. Affects elements like 'Виробництво пневмопідвіски · Україна · 20 років' and slide number badges.
ui_bugs.recommendation: Review if this is intentional truncation. If not, add proper text wrapping or increase badge width. May be false positive from detection script picking up inline elements.
